title: Concertina Rollouts — Compact Vertical Timeline for Nested AB/Canary Sequences
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, vertically oriented "concertina" timeline and composer for the Redwood Console that lets engineers and PMs author nested rollout sequences (e.g., canary -> A/B -> ramp) with in-line confidence indicators, metric overlays, and one-click emergency snapback. The UI should emphasize density (for power users) while remaining legible for cross-functional stakeholders. Includes an interactive Figma prototype, keyboard-first micro-interactions, and a simulation sandbox for previewing traffic transitions and expected latency/cost impact.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable Figma prototype that covers: create nested stage, edit traffic splits, define phased duration, attach signal assertions, and emergency snapback
Usability test with 5 platform engineers + 3 PMs capturing time-to-create and error rate (target: <2 min, <2 mistakes)
Dev-ready component spec (tokens, states, ARIA roles) handed off with redlines and CSS variables
Simulation sandbox showing a 3-stage scenario with metric overlays (error-rate, latency, token-cost) and a functional rollback control
Accessibility audit: keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, color contrast pass WCAG AA
